hebrewText: וְ/הָ/אָ֗רֶץ לֹ֤א תִמָּכֵר֙ לִ/צְמִתֻ֔ת כִּי לִ֖/י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי גֵרִ֧ים וְ/תוֹשָׁבִ֛ים אַתֶּ֖ם עִמָּדִֽ/י

tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

excision, i.e. destruction; used only (adverbially) with prepositional prefix to extinction, i.e. perpetually
